project.title: Ken Arok: Takdir dari Tumapel — Prototype 30s
project.style: cinematic realistic, Javanese period drama, dark-fantasy tones

instructions_for_agent.purpose: Batch generate all images untuk prototype 30 detik. 2 phase berurutan dengan dependency.

phase_1_master_ref.description: Generate 6 master reference images. Tidak ada dependency — boleh parallel.
phase_1_master_ref.output: save each image to its output_path

phase_2_storyboard_frame.description: Generate 6 storyboard frames. Setiap frame butuh ref image dari phase 1 sebagai input.
phase_2_storyboard_frame.input: text prompt + ref images (upload ref images yang sesuai ref_image_inputs)
phase_2_storyboard_frame.ref_image_rule: Hanya asset dengan include_inspiration_in_image_gen=true yang perlu diupload sebagai ref. Karakter utama = true (konsistensi wajah). Prop sekunder = false (hemat token).
phase_2_storyboard_frame.output: save each image to its output_path

jobs.prompt:
Cinematic realistic character reference sheet of Ken Arok / Ranggah Rajasa, founder of Singhasari, 13th century AD (1222), Tumapel, East Java — founder of Singhasari kingdom, shown in 5 different angles arranged in a horizontal grid layout on a clean solid light cream studio background. Layout: left-to-right — frontal face close-up, full body front view, side face profile close-up, side full body view holding the Keris Mpu Gandring (cursed keris of legend), back full body view. All 5 angles show the exact same single character, same costume, same physical features, same identity. Male, 25-35 years old, Javanese phenotype with golden brown skin, sharp ambitious features, intense determined eyes. Black hair in simple topknot (not yet royal — commoner origin). Lean muscular build from military life. Scar on left cheek from combat. Tattoo marks on arms (commoner tradition). Wearing simple warrior attire: leather chest armor, woven cloth kain, simple iron keris at waist. After becoming king: gold makuta, gold necklace, red silk kemben. The character bridges commoner-to-king transformation. Clean studio background, no environment, no historical setting, no other characters.

Lighting: studio 5500K even key light from above-front, soft fill from left, low ambient. Even neutral lighting for character reference, no dramatic lighting.

Mood: neutral studio reference, character turnaround for production consistency. Rags to raja — Ken Arok, the commoner who killed Tunggul Ametung, became king of Tumapel, and defeated Kadiri in 1222. Sri Ranggah Rajasa Bhatara Sang Amurwabhumi — founder of the Rajasa dynasty that would produce both Singhasari and Majapahit kings.

Style: photorealistic skin texture with visible pores and imperfections, 35mm film grain, deep depth of field f/8, 50mm lens, 8K hyperdetailed, color graded neutral, production reference aesthetic. Aspect ratio 16:9 horizontal. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.

Avoid: dramatic lighting, environment background, historical setting, multiple different characters, inconsistent costume between angles, modern clothing, anime style, cartoon, 3D render, plastic skin, deformed hands, extra fingers, watermark, text, signature, low resolution, blurry, oversaturated.
jobs.notes: Character ref sheet 5-angle horizontal untuk Ken Arok

Draped in a tattered off-white unbleached cotton robe wrapped across the left shoulder in traditional Brahmin style, paired with a matching loose dhoti-style wrap reaching his calves. Long rosary of carved dark brown rudraksha beads around his neck. Bare feet with worn leather thong sandals tied at the ankles. Calm, penetrating, spiritual presence. Clean studio background, no environment, no historical setting, no other characters.

jobs.prompt:
Cinematic realistic location reference of Hutan Tumapel, a sprawling tropical teak forest in 13th century East Java — NO people, NO characters, NO humans, empty location reference. Towering teak trees with dry peeling bark, dense canopy filtering harsh midday sun into sharp diagonal god rays cutting through mist. Tangled thorny undergrowth, ferns, vines, moss-covered fallen logs spanning across narrow dirt trails. Ground is dry sun-baked earth mixed with patches of damp mud, scattered with golden-brown teak leaves. Limestone boulders half-buried in undergrowth. A narrow winding footpath worn into the forest floor, suggesting frequent foot traffic. Distant misty forest layers creating depth. Wild, untamed, primal Javanese woodland at the height of dry season.

Lighting: harsh midday sun, ~5500K, strong directional god rays from upper-right at 45 degrees, high contrast with deep shadows in undergrowth, volumetric atmospheric haze. Raking light catching dust motes.

Mood: ancient, primal, foreboding yet sacred. A forest where bandits hide and sages appear. Setting for the legendary encounter between Ken Arok and Dang Hyang Lohgawe.

Style: photorealistic natural texture, 24mm wide-angle lens, deep depth of field f/11, hyperdetailed foliage, 8K, cinematic color grade warm earthy tones with golden god rays. Aspect ratio 16:9 horizontal. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.

Avoid: people, humans, characters, figures, silhouettes, modern buildings, modern roads, vehicles, plastic-looking foliage, cartoon, anime, 3D render, oversaturated greens, watermark, text, low resolution, blurry.
jobs.notes: Location ref (no people) untuk Hutan Tumapel

jobs.prompt:
Cinematic realistic location reference of Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel, the audience hall of the Akuwu (regent) of Tumapel in 13th century East Java — NO people, NO characters, NO humans, empty location reference. Cavernous open-sided pendopo with massive carved teakwood pillars supporting a steeply pitched ijuk (palm fiber) thatched roof. Polished hard-packed earth floor with intricate geometric stone carvings inset at the center. Raised dais at the far end with an ornate carved wooden throne inlaid with semiprecious stones. Stone steps leading up to the dais. Woven bamboo wall panels between pillars at the back. Bronze oil lamps and torches mounted on iron brackets along pillars. Decorative pendopo fabric banners in deep crimson and gold hanging between pillars. Sunlight streams through open sides creating dramatic shafts of light across the stone floor. Distant view of tropical garden through the open archways. Cavernous, hushed, oppressive atmosphere of a petty tyrant's court.

Lighting: mixed — warm 3200K torchlight from oil lamps on pillars, cool 5500K daylight streaming through open sides, high contrast between shadow and light. Volumetric god rays from side openings. Cinematic chiaroscuro.

Mood: oppressive grandeur, hushed anticipation, tyrant's domain. Setting where Ken Arok first sees Ken Dedes and is struck by the prophecy of her divine radiance.

Style: photorealistic architectural detail, 24mm wide-angle lens, deep depth of field f/11, 8K hyperdetailed wood grain and stone texture, cinematic color grade warm torchlight against cool daylight. Aspect ratio 16:9 horizontal. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.

jobs.prompt:
Cinematic realistic macro artifact reference of a Sekantung Beras (small sack of unhusked rice) — a coarse loosely woven brown jute sack bound tightly around the bunched neck with frayed hemp twine, used as a prop in 13th century East Java. The sack is partially filled with raw unhulled rice grains, showing patchy dirt smears and a few loose white rice grains poking through strained seam punctures. The lower half is visibly plump and molded by the shifting bulk of small grain within. Natural wear, frayed threads at the binding, slight moisture stains. The sack rests on a dark slate surface for studio macro shot. Empty, no people.

Lighting: studio macro — 4000K soft key light from upper-left at 30 degrees, gentle fill from right, dark neutral background. Even macro lighting to reveal weave texture and grain detail.

Mood: utilitarian, humble, the loot of a thief. A coarse peasant's rice sack snatched by Ken Arok during his bandit days — symbol of his low origins before destiny elevated him.

Style: photorealistic macro photography, 100mm macro lens, f/8 deep depth of field for product detail, 8K hyperdetailed jute fiber weave, color graded neutral warm tones. Aspect ratio 1:1 square. High detail, 4K, sharp focus.

Avoid: people, hands, modern packaging, plastic, branded sacks, cartoon, anime, 3D render, watermark, text, low resolution, blurry, oversaturated colors.
jobs.notes: Prop macro ref untuk Sekantung Beras
